notes.title: Framework for Better animation mechanics
notes.content:
Part of my promise of making Milfvania Ep. 3 (final)'s adult scenes fully animated. This means not only loops but also in between movements that will make the characters more lively. For this I made a small framework that's able to move between animated stances (idle, foot taping + blinking to fancy posing)

No, i'm not advancing the pose via click, the pose will change based on timing or some other game mechanic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417806/e944cad04089151354ed018a0f4b5e078b0992ab.gif

What i'm trying to achieve with these:

 scenes that feel more lively, including some finish options selectable directly on character's bodies
 body transitions rather than scene transitions
 different camera angles selectable from the animation screen + maybe the button itself as a miniscreen displaying that view


I also plan rather than have many positions featured in a scene I should concentrate on fewer ones but with more motion variation and keep the other ideas for another scene later in the game. Also to even them out better throughout the story.

Of course this will require a better computer to run these interactive animations (not a rocket or something, but a 2gb ram pc might struggle). Don't worry, I'll add movies as well and an option to toggle between one or another.
